summary: Wide residential kerb with a motorhome parked nearby; homes 19 m away on this side.
reasons: Homes 19 m away on own side
Cars and a motorhome park on this road

best_section.where: Meiers Road south kerb, just past the bend, beside the house with the long curved roof sheds

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes line the south side; nearest to this section is 19 m (at 158 m), others 10 m at 110 m and 180 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Open kerb on a wide sealed road, no gate; trees and hedge on the verge but room to park along the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Residential collector with moderate traffic; a camper and cars park on the road.
drivers.convention: A motorhome and several cars are parked on the north kerb opposite; one No Stopping Any Time sign near the 0 m end only.

flags: Slope about 1% here, mean 3.7% over the stretch
No Stopping Any Time sign near the 0 m start
Homes 10 m away just before and after the section
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sun; hedge and trees on the south side give some afternoon shade.
